Name: Pokemon Day Care - Interface
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Interface[/b][/size]

Your whole game, dressed for a Pokemon adventure: menus, title screen, cursor, fonts and money.

[b]Three styles[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Creamy[/b] (default): the original interface in soft beige, cream and light brown, maps included. It also restyles the menus of other popular mods.[/*]
[*][b]Pokemon[/b]: flat, clean frames in the colour of your choice, with little Poke Balls in the corners.[/*]
[*][b]Origine[/b]: the original Stardew look, keeping the Pokemon touches you like.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Title screen[/b]
[list]
[*]A Pokemon Day Care logo, with title buttons drawn in Pokemon style.[/*]
[*]Pikachu says hello on the "Developed by ConcernedApe" screen. Click him![/*]
[*]Squirtle, Charmander and Bulbasaur replace the Junimos.[/*]
[*]Flying Pokemon cross the sky: choose how many, their size, legendaries, ghosts and the shiny chance. Click to make more appear.[/*]
[*]Prefer the vanilla logo? Keep it, with Pokemon sprites on the buttons.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Poke Ball cursor[/b]
[list]
[*]25 Balls to choose from, each with a small arrow for precise aiming. Or turn it off.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Texts[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pokedollars[/b]: gold becomes ₽ everywhere: shops, dialogue, mail, quests (English and French).[/*]
[*][b]Game Boy fonts[/b] for texts and menus, with French accents.[/*]
[*]A search bar on the Social and Animals pages: type a name, a nickname or a species.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Community Center[/b]
[list]
[*]The Junimo scroll shows a Poke Ball, and in Creamy, the bundle menu has a Poke Ball watermark.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other mods, in Creamy[/b]
Generic Mod Config Menu, Fashion Sense, Event Lookup, Better Jukebox, Deluxe Journal, Ferngill Simple Economy, Vanilla Plus Professions, Stardew & Chill.

[b]Languages[/b]
English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Hungarian, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

[b]Settings[/b]
Everything on one page in Generic Mod Config Menu: style, cursor, texts, Pokemon style colours, title screen and flying Pokemon.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Safe to add or remove at any time.
[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod ID changed to Parme.PokemonDayCareInterface. Delete the old folder before installing this one.

[b]Credits[/b]
The Creamy style uses retinted images from DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface and related mods (Maeyary, N3cro_92 and others).
Fonts: "Pokemon GB" by Jackster Productions. See CREDITS.txt.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion

Manifest.Name: Pokemon Day Care - Interface
Manifest.Description: Restyles the whole interface in three styles: Pokemon (any colour, Poke Balls), Creamy (beige and cream, the default) or Origine (vanilla). Pokemon title screen, Pikachu splash, Poke Ball cursors, flying Pokemon, Pokedollars, Game Boy fonts, a search bar for villagers and animals, and support for the interfaces of other popular mods.
Manifest.Author: Parme69
